ratifier_payload.bounded_rationale: Retain the family as an index/composition namespace, but split semantic authority by mathematical formalism: statistical inference, causal inference, forecasting, process mining, graph, spatial, document/text/IR, signal/image and numerical kernels. Method libraries remain pure and cannot own study acceptance, business decision or effect authority.
ratifier_payload.invalidation_condition: Reopen if stronger primary evidence, an authority change, or a material counterexample changes the bounded decision.

ratifier_payload.bounded_rationale: Retain application behavior as a provider-neutral index and composition family, but split semantic authority by bounded context. Application contexts own commands, aggregate transitions, workflows, projections and business event meaning; OpenAPI/HTTP own interface and transport descriptions; CloudEvents owns envelope structure; SCXML/BPMN own state/process notation; persistence and messaging own physical guarantees; security owns authorization; provenance owns evidence relations; effect gateways own attempted external effects; product and vertical contexts own business acceptance. The family may connect these contracts but cannot collapse their authorities.
ratifier_payload.invalidation_condition: Reopen if a primary specification materially changes one of these bounded contracts, an application-context counterexample defeats the split, a library cannot preserve the declared authority imports, or a named semantic owner supplies stronger evidence for rehoming a contract.
ratifier_payload.record_level_rule: Retain each library record only where it preserves command != event, query != projection, aggregate transition != persistence, workflow != generic dataflow, compensation != rollback, event envelope != business meaning, decision result != authorization, effect intent != executed effect, and execution receipt != accepted outcome. Narrow, split, rehome, or reject any field that imports another bounded context without an explicit authority reference and loss/refusal rule.
rejected_inferences: interface or schema validity => business semantic validity
HTTP idempotence => domain idempotence or transactional atomicity
event envelope conformance => delivery guarantee, business meaning, or consumer authority
workflow/state notation => portable runtime semantics or effect authority
provenance or execution receipt => truth, independent assurance, or accepted outcome
application orchestration => ownership of persistence, messaging, security, runtime, data, product, or vertical semantics
